tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background on web, courier app and station screens. The warm off-white of uncoated paper.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: order cards, upload panel, dialogs, the station's active step.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between list rows and sections only. Never the sole boundary of a control (it is below 3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and card-control borders; 3.4:1 on paper, so it can be a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, card and dash-soft (15:1+). Fill of the primary button, with paper text on it. Also the text on any dash fill (11:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, helper text on paper, card and dash-soft (5.8:1+).

tokens.name: dash
tokens.usage: The brand accent, as a FILL only: the dash mark, the current step in Upload > Configure > Pay > Collect, the locker-ready banner. Text and icons on it are always ink. Never text, never a border on paper (1.4:1).

tokens.name: dash-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind ink text: price summary, highlighted PIN panel, selected station.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Positive and in-progress states (Printed, Ready, Out for delivery), links and the focus ring. As text on paper, card, dash-soft (5.3:1+). Always paired with a status word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed prints, payment declined, station offline. As text on paper, card, dash-soft (5.7:1+). Always paired with a status word or icon; differs from info by hue family (blue vs red), never by green vs red.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero and the station idle screen. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the station's step heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload a PDF, Word or image file up to 50 MB.
styles.usage: All running text and form values. Never smaller on the station.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, metadata, table cells on admin screens.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Pickup PINs, courier tokens and order numbers shown to be typed or read aloud. Group digits in threes or fours.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related fields, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing, station screen margins, desktop gutters.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs, lockers in the station map.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Step indicator dots and the dash mark only.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control on web and the courier app.

tokens.name: target-station
tokens.usage: Minimum control height on the station touchscreen, used standing and in gloves.
